quote: I will seize Fate by the throat; it shall certainly not bend and crush me completely — Oh, it would be so lovely to live a thousand lives.
source: Ludwig van Beethoven, Letter to Franz Gerhard Wegeler, 16 November 1801, The Letters of Beethoven, vol. I (trans. Emily Anderson, 1961)

Scans are lending only, so the page was not opened.
